headline: Committee recommends Reimagine Franklin Street design concept to City Council, 3-0; Central Main Power transmission corridor was discussed.
summary: The committee heard a sustainability update and a panel on Central Main Power's proposed transmission corridor. It took public comment on the Reimagine Franklin Street plan and recommended it to the City Council. The Vision Zero update was postponed to November.
decisions: Recommended the Reimagine Franklin Street design concept to the City Council, 3-0.
discussion: Central Main Power transmission corridor: Members asked about routing along Interstate 295, underground costs, the 547 million estimate, and who pays. Panelists said the route mostly uses existing corridors and that the Public Utilities Commission review runs to July 2027.

Franklin Street redesign: Public commenters raised turn lanes, medians, traffic backups, safety at Marginal Way, and the size of Lincoln Park. Members asked about the Boyd Street Community Garden, parking, trees, and affordable housing on city land.
Stradora Dam study: Staff proposed a study of the dam with funding from a partnership. Members agreed to move forward, and no vote was taken.
Vision Zero update: The update was postponed at the mayor's request so the committee could give more time to a median strip ordinance, with discussion set for November.

decision_evidence.quote: And I will take a motion to move the Reimagine Franklin Arterial to the City Council. So moved. Second. ... Councilor Ali. Yes. Councilor Bullitt. Yay. And I'm a yes.

problems.what: recommended, but the decision or the minutes don't say so
